name: Records Manager
description: Administers corporate records across the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream, supporting board meeting planning, secretarial filings, and legal entity administration. Maintains director fee and equity award records, coordinates e-discovery readiness with IT, and supports records system migration projects while keeping regulatory filings and retention practices compliant.

name: Recruiter Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Performs end-to-end talent acquisition within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, from requisition management and sourcing strategy through candidate screening, interviews, and offer management. Drafts job descriptions, builds compensation offers within grade bands, maintains employer branding and career site content, and validates contingent labor requests in the HRIS.

name: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description: Leads compliance issue response and regulatory change management within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream. Triages and logs compliance issues, assigns investigation leads, escalates major matters to the CCO, and tracks examination corrective-action plans. Oversees third-party and cyber risk monitoring and validates KRI data quality on the GRC platform.

name: Regulatory Attorney
description: Provides regulatory legal counsel across the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream, responding to regulator objection letters and negotiating resolutions with the DOI. Supports regulatory filing management, political contributions compliance, and board governance matters, prepares executive stakeholder briefings, and documents settlements and disclosures to keep the enterprise's regulatory positions defensible.

name: Regulatory Counsel
description: Advises on regulatory matters within the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream, handling regulator objection letters, DOI negotiations, and acceleration disclosures. Supports secretarial filings, legal entity administration, and contract financial obligations management, obtaining business unit sign-off on commercial terms and reporting political contributions activity to governance.

name: Regulatory Filing Specialist
description: Performs regulatory filing and compliance support within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, logging and triaging compliance issues and building examination corrective-action plans. Tracks remediation progress, supports regulatory change management and market conduct risk assessments, and monitors third-party vendors against SLAs using the GRC platform.

name: Regulatory Reporting Analyst
description: Performs statutory and regulatory reporting analysis across the Actuarial and Product & Delivery value streams. Assembles Actuarial Opinion Summary exhibits, clears NAIC annual statement validation edits, drafts statement notes and prior-year development commentary, and calculates the provision for reinsurance using actuarial modeling platforms and the data warehouse.

name: Regulatory Reporting Manager
description: Oversees statutory reporting within the Finance & Investments value stream, directing financial statement preparation, reserve setting, and financial examination management. Calculates actuarial liability balances, prepares statutory reserve schedules, and reconciles claims and ALAE data for completeness, while supporting capital instruments and share repurchase program reporting on the general ledger.

name: Reinsurance Accountant
description: Owns reinsurance accounting across the Reinsurance value stream, reconciling reinsurer balances to statements of account, posting period-end accruals and reclassifications, and preparing the ceded reinsurance close package. Supports premium settlement, collateral management, and profit commission reconciliation, and documents retrocession structures for management approval with compliance corrective actions applied.

name: Reinsurance Actuary
description: Performs reinsurance-focused actuarial analysis within the Actuarial value stream, constructing loss triangles, monitoring reserve development, and updating ceded loss estimates each reserve cycle. Delivers board actuarial reporting and prior-year development analysis, benchmarks tail factor selections against industry schedules, and incorporates stress outcomes into ORSA and ICAAP on actuarial modeling platforms.

name: Reinsurance Analyst
description: Performs placement and program analysis across the Reinsurance value stream, supporting retrocession structuring, program structuring, and alternative-capital design including cat bonds. Prepares cash call requests and the ceded reinsurance close package, reconciles reinsurer balances, supports external audits, and documents authority bases for reinsurance regulatory reporting.

name: Reinsurance Claims / Recoveries Specialist
description: Coordinates reinsurance recoveries within the Reinsurance value stream, preparing and submitting recovery billing statements to reinsurers and registering inbound facultative submissions. Handles assumed claims loss advice intake, confirms cedant reporting compliance against notification thresholds, and prepares governance committee packs and regulatory reporting in coordination with compliance and audit.

name: Reinsurance Credit & Security Analyst
description: Performs reinsurer credit and security analysis within the Reinsurance value stream, preparing recovery billing statements and confirming cedant reporting compliance against notification thresholds. Supports retrocession structuring, slip and assumed contract wording execution, and net-retention setting, and assembles governance committee packs and regulatory reporting coordinated with compliance and audit.
